Here's a description of the provided plot, following the guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between training time and loss for two different models. The x-axis is labeled “Training Time (s)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 250000, with tick labels at intervals of 50000. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. A purple line, labeled “Vanilla”, begins at approximately 2.72 at a training time of 0 seconds and decreases to approximately 2.48 at a training time of 250000 seconds, with a relatively steady decline. A red line, labeled “SepLLM”, begins at approximately 2.71 at a training time of 0 seconds and decreases to approximately 2.46 at a training time of 250000 seconds, also with a relatively steady decline. A horizontal dashed green line is present at a loss value of 2.45, spanning the entire x-axis. A dashed box highlights the region between 126000 and 250000 seconds on the x-axis.
